subject.title: chore(deps): bump the actions group across 1 directory with 14 updates

question: Should OpenClaw accept these 14 upstream action revisions as one grouped update across secret-bearing, publishing, security-scanning, and repository-automation workflows?
rationale: Code review can verify immutable pins and call-site compatibility, but only an owner can accept the supply-chain trust change and operational blast radius across privileged workflows.

options.title: Approve the grouped pins
options.body: Verify upstream release provenance and exact-head required checks, then merge the grouped immutable-pin refresh.

options.title: Split privileged actions
options.body: Separate Codex, token-minting, Docker publishing, and security-scanning actions into smaller PRs for independent approval and rollback.

recommendation.title: Approve the grouped pins
recommendation.body: Verify upstream release provenance and exact-head required checks, then merge the grouped immutable-pin refresh.

likelyOwner.reason: The history most strongly connects this person to release, security, Docker, and repository-wide workflow decisions.
